open_function_group.name: Axis steppers and drivers unreported
open_function_group.source_line: Fecn describes making a CNC router from MDF and repurposed heavy-duty server-rack slides. The build used threaded rod identified in the forum as M8 × 1.5 and bearings. The builder says he used three drawer slides per axis orientation to reduce play. The posts describe stepper motors and drivers but do not identify their models, the exact slide model, full travel, or measured stiffness and backlash.
